verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant, so a deep research capability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions autonomous multi-source web research, research runs, or cited reports. It covers only messaging channels, integrations, MCP extensibility, website creation, charts and human-task delegation, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report
